M-WIDGET-GEOMETRY.Purpose: Build and publish one geometry snapshot consumed by rendering, coordinate conversion, clipping and pointer targeting.

Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Flexbox calculation and IMGUI execution remain outside this module.

Requirements.REQ-001: Refresh builds entries from layout rectangles, local padding boxes and current widget transforms, Overflow and stable sibling ZIndex order before publishing them together.
Requirements.REQ-002: Each entry retains parent, paint children, layout rect, self/child/world/inverse matrices, invertibility and local child clip.
Requirements.REQ-003: Readers observe published values until the next refresh; entries from previous publications remain unchanged.
Requirements.REQ-004: Native child-space changes request a full refresh; selective invalidation and viewport culling are separate concerns.

Outputs.OUT-001: Published read-only geometry for the live tree.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Replaces the engine snapshot after successful capture.
